name: Orient Ceratech Limited
summary: Orient Ceratech Limited, headquartered in Mumbai, makes and distributes high-temperature ceramic materials, including refractory and monolithic products. It operates two segments: alumina refractories, monolithics and bauxite ore extraction, and power generation. Its aluminous products include white and brown fused alumina, fused mullite, zirconia mullite, calcined bauxite and chamotte.
